interface.longDescription: Move, count and make ten. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Make ten; Count back; Find the missing part. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.

prompts: Help me find the missing part.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Grade 1 Math workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.prompt: Help me make ten with these supplied values: {"a":8,"b":7}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses grade_1_math_make_ten with the supplied inputs. Returns {"a":8,"b":7,"total":15,"move_to_first":2,"first_after":10,"remaining":5,"steps":["8 + 7","10 + 5","Total: 15"]}. Shows the actual counters result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.prompt: Help me count back with these supplied values: {"start":14,"take":6}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses grade_1_math_count_back with the supplied inputs. Returns {"start":14,"take":6,"answer":8,"hops":[14,13,12,11,10,9,8]}. Shows the actual number-line result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Find the missing part. Reproducible inputs: {"whole":13,"known":8}
positive.prompt: Help me find the missing part with these supplied values: {"whole":13,"known":8}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses grade_1_math_missing_part with the supplied inputs. Returns {"whole":13,"known":8,"missing":5,"check":"8 + 5 = 13"}. Shows the actual part-whole result. Does not fabricate external data.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.2.2 fixes document export for the actual ChatGPT sandbox using host-mediated file APIs and content-versioned UI resources. Includes three validated math workflows, launch/workspace entrypoints, versioned document import and export, preserved workflow drafts, and recoverable input errors.
